correctness.rationale: The lower bound is reconstructed from first principles. For a uniform measure on \(2N\) indexed atoms, the equal-weight \(W_1\) quantization problem equals minimum perfect-matching length divided by \(2N\), by integrality of the finite transportation polytope and the triangle inequality. The multiscale grid has second moment at most \(1/8\); every special point has the stated scale separation; summing the matching edge lower bounds gives \(e_{N;2,1}\ge (1/64)\sqrt{K/N}\), with \(K\asymp\log N\). Seeger's Theorem 1.1 independently supplies the matching upper order. Finite verification is supplementary, not a proof of the asymptotic theorem.
